description: Integer literals wider than a 64-bit long (Snowflake NUMBER(38,0) allows up to 38 digits): a 22-digit literal parses as an exact decimal in SELECT, survives arithmetic (+1 lands on the exact neighbour), inserts into and compares against NUMBER(38,0) columns, and ordinary literals are unaffected. Exact-value pins are stringified with '<...>' so the harness's significant-figure normalization cannot mask a low-digit drift. Converted 1:1 from features/LargeIntegerLiteralTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE t (row_id NUMBER(38,0), c INTEGER)
SELECT '<' || row_id || '>' FROM t WHERE c = 5
SELECT c FROM t WHERE row_id = 9000000000000000000002
